title: Crispy Hazelnut Pho Bites
description: Crispy pho bites filled with a sweet and nutty hazelnut filling. Perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Cook the pho noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, blend the hazelnuts and sugar until finely ground.
Add the winey rice vinegar and blend until well combined.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked pho noodles, hazelnut mixture, and crispy fried onions.
Using a small cookie scoop or spoon, drop the mixture into balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
